description: This file contains implementations for a generic storage class using blob storage, including a storage factory and extension methods to configure the storage within a silo builder in Orleans.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorage`1
classes.description: A generic storage implementation that uses blob storage, providing save and info retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of BlobExampleStorage using dependency injection and context accessor.

classes.name: BlobExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring BlobExampleStorage in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorage`1.Name
methods.description: Returns the name associated with the storage configuration.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorage`1.State
methods.description: Property to get or set the current state stored in the blob storage.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorage`1.Save
methods.description: Asynchronous method to save the current state; currently implemented as a completed task.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorage`1.GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with detailed information about the storage and its state type.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorage`1.Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage instance with the provided storage configuration.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorageFactory.Create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new storage instance for the specified state type.

methods.name: BlobExampleStorageExtensions.UseBlobExampleStorage
methods.description: Extension method to integrate BlobExampleStorage with Orleans silo builder.
